integrity: The complete proof, independently reconstructed exact finite-graph checks and explicit asymptotic remainder are supplied. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is for finite simple leaf-decorated paths with q>=2 and uniform random vertex arrival orders. The distribution is given by an exact finite recurrence, not closed coefficient expressions; the asymptotic statement concerns only the mean, not variance or a central limit law. Historical priority remains conditional on the literature examined.
title: Exact random-greedy independence laws on uniformly leaf-decorated paths
